name: AskFRED Tournament Pages by Fencer Level
description: Fetch public AskFRED tournament listings, classify them into Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, and D1 / Elite pages, then export the structured rows to Excel.

nodes.name: Schedule
nodes.notes: Run manually or weekly to refresh fencing tournament pages.

nodes.name: AskFRED Fetch Tournaments
nodes.notes: Fetch AskFRED public tournament listings and classify each event by likely fencer level. Uses sample fallback rows if the live page cannot be parsed during a demo.

nodes.name: Build Page Rows
nodes.notes: Normalize tournament fields into a page-ready table. Each row includes the target page slug and page title.

nodes.name: Export Tournament Excel
nodes.notes: Export the tournament rows into an Excel workbook. Filter or split by page_slug to create Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, and D1 / Elite sheets.

nodes.name: CellX Tournament Pages
nodes.notes: Optional: after creating a CellX table such as cx_askfred_tournaments, map these rows into CellX so each level can power a separate page.

nodes.name: Write Tournament Log
nodes.notes: Record run count, source URL, and page grouping status.

nodes.name: Text AskFRED Summary
nodes.notes: Send a compact AskFRED summary by Gmail and T-Mobile SMS gateway recipients.

integrationSettings.bodyTemplate: AskFRED: {{row_count}} tournaments found. Beginner {{pages.0.row_count}}, Intermediate {{pages.1.row_count}}, Advanced {{pages.2.row_count}}, D1 {{pages.3.row_count}}. Top: {{rows.0.title}} {{rows.0.location}} {{rows.0.tournament_url}}
